verdict.rationale: Browserbase exposes a broad API/SDK surface (sessions, downloads, webhooks, agent deployment) per docs-1,4,18,19,22, but several capabilities are described as dashboard-only, e.g. creating an Agent 'from the dashboard by describing the goal' and the Optimize tool that 'lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard' (docs-16, docs-25), with no documented API equivalent. No public OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2 all 404s), making it hard to verify full UI/API parity. missing for 10: documented API equivalents for dashboard-only agent creation/Optimize workflows, a public OpenAPI reference confirming full endpoint parity, independent verification of parity claims.
